useful: overview: monthly level per direction exposed the March 2022 collapse, the Dec 2025 step at 162 and the June 2026 direction flip at 175
zeros(counter=True) with a daytime filter: listed every outage with precise start/end times
compare(162,[160]): a very steady ~0.5 ratio showed counter 104 and 148 read alike, and isolated the Dec 2025 step and the 2022/2025 under-counts to site 162
raw speeds: unchanged speeds after the Dec 2025 step argued against pedestrians, and swapped speeds confirmed the label swaps
doubled + network: showed 2022-02-19 was a feed-wide doubling and 2025-10-23 a feed-wide outage
hourly: AM/PM peak direction revealed the Nov 2025 label swap at 162
not_useful: spikes: dominated by the lockdown and post-Dec-2025 level, little new information here
duplicates: nothing found (1 record per slot throughout)
improve: hourly: an option to return one summed row per site or an AM/PM ratio per day/week would save custom code
zeros: an option to merge overnight-to-midday stretches into one per-day summary, since daily partial failures (2022-03) produce dozens of rows
daily: include the direction's speed median so label swaps and sensor changes show without going to raw
add: a per-week direction fingerprint (AM/PM share, median speed) per direction, flagging when two directions swap characteristics — this would find label swaps after reinstalls directly
a first-count-of-day / last-count-of-day tool, which shows tube sensitivity failures like March-May 2022

summary: Site 162 (Hawthorne Canal): counter 104 failed in the mornings from March to early April 2022 (set missing, recovery uncertain to mid-May); counter 148 has several zero outages, swapped direction labels at its Nov 2025 reinstall, and stepped to 2-3x from 2025-12-13 with no matching change nearby (kept, flagged uncertain, series split). Site 175 (High St Randwick): counter 211 continues counter 148 at the same level, with many zero outages set missing and a direction-label swap at the 2026-06-09 reinstall, handled with dated series parts; 2022-02-19 was a feed-wide doubling (scaled 0.5 at 162).
